name: Crude Charm
summary: A Crude Charm is carried by Kolkar centaurs in Desolace. Uthek the Wise asks for them to show the Kolkar that their magic is weak.

sections.title: Charms of the Kolkar
sections.body: Uthek the Wise wants the Kolkar's charms brought to Gelkis Village, to be thrown in the fire as proof that Kolkar magic cannot protect them. Her contempt for the Kolkar is plain, and she expects their fear to weaken them further.

faq.answer: A Crude Charm is carried by Kolkar centaurs in Desolace and sought by Uthek the Wise in Gelkis Village.
Uthek the Wise of Gelkis Village wants the Kolkar's Crude Charms.

faq.q: Why does Uthek want Crude Charms?
faq.answer: Uthek means to burn the Kolkar charms to show that their magic is weak.

faq.q: What do the Gelkis want from the Kolkar?
faq.answer: Uthek wants the Kolkar shown that their magic is pathetic, and believes their fear will leave them even more feeble.
